format: Perl/Assembly hybrid (script with embedded ARM assembly code)
description: This file contains a Perl script that generates ARM assembly code for a cryptographic function implementing a modular inverse using the Binary Extended GCD algorithm, specifically for the P-256 curve. It includes external references to other scripts and functions, and defines a complex assembly routine for cryptographic computations.

methods.name: TEST_B_ZERO
methods.description: Checks if the B register is zero, used in the main algorithm loop.

methods.name: SHIFT1
methods.description: Performs a right shift by one bit on multi-word registers, adding the modulus if the value is odd.

methods.name: SHIFT256
methods.description: Performs a variable right shift on 256-bit values represented as four 64-bit words, with bitwise operations to handle shifting across word boundaries.
